questions.description: The full name or preferred name of the groom, so the speech feels personal and accurate.
questions.title: What is the groom's name?

questions.title: What is the bride's (or partner's) name?

questions.description: For example: mostly funny and light-hearted, heartfelt and emotional, or a balanced mix of both.
questions.title: What tone do you want for the speech?

questions.description: A favourite anecdote, funny moment, or meaningful memory about the groom that you'd like to feature in the speech.
questions.title: Do you have a specific story or memory you want included?

questions.description: For example: short (2-3 minutes), standard (4-5 minutes), or longer (6+ minutes).
questions.title: How long should the speech be?

questions.description: Any topics, people, or past events that should be kept out of the speech — exes, sensitive family matters, embarrassing details, etc.
questions.title: Is there anything you want to avoid mentioning?

gold.taskDescription: Write a personalized and memorable best man speech for an upcoming wedding.
